paper_title: Search of spin-dependent fifth forces with precision magnetometry
notes: Fig.4 upper panel, blue "This work" curve = product g_s^N g_p^e (scalar nucleon coupling of lead source masses x pseudoscalar electron coupling of the GSO paramagnetic-crystal electron spins), the paper's headline monopole-dipole electron-nucleon limit at 95% C.L. x-axis converted from the figure lambda [m] to mediator mass via m = 1.97e-7 eV*m / lambda; the figure top axis (m in ueV) confirms this mapping. y-axis calibrated from tick strokes + axis-label glyphs (10^-28 @ y=97.0, 10^-31 @169.7, 10^-34 @242.4; 24.23 px/decade); vertical decades anchored at lambda=0.01,1,100,1e4 m. The plotted flat asymptote is 3.8e-32 for lambda>~0.3 m (mass<~7e-7 eV); note the abstract/text quote g_p^e g_s^N<=5.7e-32 for lambda>~10 cm, i.e. the plotted curve sits a factor ~1.5 below the quoted round number (a genuine paper feature; the lower panel g_p^e g_s^e shows the same ~1.4x offset, plotted ~1.1e-31 vs quoted 1.6e-31). Both values are well within a factor 2. Curve traced across full drawn extent (lambda~2.8e-3 to ~1e5 m). A secondary electron-electron limit g_p^e g_s^e (Fig.4 lower panel) is derived under the assumption A=2.5Z and is not reported here. Not a DM search: density-independent.
